title: Make the harness stop asserting what it has not verified: prove every acceptance criterion both red-before and green-after, give a criterion found inexecutable a sanctioned repair path, let a plan declare duties to verify the world outside the repository, surface the dependency-precheck skip on unsupported stacks, discover in-flight specs across work branches, distinguish a never-dispatched plan from wave 1, and record a deliberately dropped checklist item as a decision instead of a pending one

waves.summary: The criterion proof gains its second half — red before, green after — and a criterion proven inexecutable gets a sanctioned repair path.
Active-spec discovery stops reporting absence it did not verify: a spec on an unmerged work branch is listed as in-flight, with the branch that holds it.
A plan can oblige a wave to verify something outside the repository, and the closing of that wave reports whether the duty was met.
Resume bootstrap and the dependency precheck stop implying what they did not check — one about progress, the other about a stack it cannot parse.
Work dropped on purpose is recorded as a decision, so it stops reading as work someone forgot.
